# backup-velero-s3

<!-- BEGIN DECLARED (generated by scripts/wiki-compile.py — do not edit) -->

> Source comment, verbatim from `kustomization.yaml`:
>
> Velero with an external S3-compatible backend (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, B2) and file-system backup.
>
> For tenants that reference the component by path, remote ones included:
> ssh://git@github.com/AItizate/forjate.git//k8s/components/apps/backup/velero/s3?ref=<tag>
>
> The tenant only patches data on the rendered BackupStorageLocation `default`: bucket,
> prefix, s3Url and region (see ../README.md, "External S3 or R2 from a remote tenant").
> Defaults are R2-ready: region auto, path-style, checksumAlgorithm "".
>
> Volume data goes through file-system backup (kopia, node agent), so no CSI
> snapshot-controller is needed; CSI snapshots are opt-in by patch.
> CRDs render as plain resources (no pre-install hook Job), which suits Argo CD.
> Argo CD needs kustomize.buildOptions: --enable-helm.
>
> Needs, supplied by the tenant: Secret `velero-credentials` in namespace velero
> (key `cloud`) and the bucket in the target store.
